description:
Extends the coding-owned tuning section with a decode selector family, so batch decoding takes its routing values from one calibrated source.

## Background

Selector values of `gf2-coding` live in its tuning section, resolved through the process-wide authority of `gf2_core::tuning`; the section holds the batch-encoding family, whose conservative values select the scalar reference. A batch decoder chooses between decoding frames one at a time and decoding a wave of eight frames in lanes, and a parallel batch decoder partitions frame groups across workers; those choices are selectors. The section keeps one wire identity and one owner codec.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The coding tuning section exposes a validated decode selector family: `lane_min_frames`, the smallest number of occupied lanes at which a wave takes the lane route; `lane_max_edges`, the largest Tanner-graph edge count that takes the lane route; and `granules_per_task`, the number of preferred-granularity frame groups one parallel task decodes.
- [hard] REQ-02: The conservative family closes the lane route for every batch and gives one group per task; each conservative value has one definition, in the tuning module.
- [hard] REQ-03: The owner codec encodes and decodes the family with per-field presence, reads a body without the family as the conservative family, rejects a null or unknown field and a zero `granules_per_task`, and decodes a committed profile that holds the encode family alone to the section it decoded to before.
- [hard] REQ-04: The section's wire identity is unchanged, the process-wide accessor resolves both families through one lookup, and the fresh-process tests observe the conservative family before installation and an installed family after it.

## Notes

The decode selectors are independent of the core section.
title: Carry decoder selectors in the coding tuning section
